meta.source: eurth.org — logo and favicon uploads, og share image, Discourse 'Light (default)' and 'Solarized Dark' colour schemes, category colours, theme components (October 2026)
meta.note: The single source for @eurth/style. Same shape as the Eurth design kit, so the two can be compared line by line. build/build.mjs turns it into dist/eurth.css; tests/contrast.test.js checks every text pair in both themes.

tokens.name: eurth-blue
tokens.usage: The brand colour: the yurt disc, the EURTH wordmark, the forum's top menu bar and the share image's CTA pill. Fill and mark colour first; as text it reads on night (4.7:1) and space (6.4:1) but only reaches 3.2:1 on paper, so blue text on paper uses accent-text instead.

tokens.name: eurth-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Intentional addition (not on the site): a darker step of eurth-blue for blue text, links and small-label fills on paper and parchment (5.5:1 with white, 5.1:1 on parchment). Never replaces eurth-blue in the logo.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The forum's dark-scheme ground (Solarized Dark base, also the dark theme-color). Default ground for staff banners and announcement graphics.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels laid on night.

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on night. Decorative only (1.3:1): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Warm off-white: the dark scheme's text colour. Headlines and body on night (13.9:1), night-raised and space; a warm alternative ground for printable or letter-style pieces.

tokens.name: parchment-muted
tokens.usage: The dark scheme's muted text: bylines, dates and captions on night (5.9:1), night-raised (5.1:1) and space (8.0:1). Fixed, so dark graphics read the same in either theme.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: Deep-space black sampled from the share image's sky. Ground for photo-led graphics; parchment, white and eurth-blue all read on it.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: The forum light scheme's text colour. Body and headlines on paper; also the label colour on eurth-blue (4.9:1) and on bright category colours.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The forum light scheme's ground and header background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page or canvas ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, quote blocks and panels on surface.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Fill of a button, chip or row under the pointer. Text on it is ink (13.9:1 light, 9.0:1 dark); muted and link colours fall below 7:1 here, so a hovered control sets its text in ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and sections. Decorative: not a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, outlined buttons, chip outlines (3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, bylines, captions and secondary lines on surface and surface-raised: 7:1 or more in both themes (WCAG AAA). The forum's own muted values (#646464 and parchment-muted) reach AA only, so tools and graphics use these.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fills that carry the brand: CTA pills, the top bar, the yurt disc, active tabs.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill at 24px and up, or bold 19px and up, as the share image's 'eurth.org' pill does (3.2:1, large text only).

tokens.name: on-accent-small
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill below 24px (4.7:1). For WCAG AAA the label must count as large text: 19px bold or bigger, as the Join Eurth pill is.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, blue words and the focus ring on surface and surface-raised: 7:1 or more in both themes (WCAG AAA). Darker and lighter steps of eurth-blue; eurth-blue-deep and the forum's #3eafe7 reach AA only.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of a chosen option and of small primary controls, where the label is under 19px bold: a darker step of eurth-blue in the light theme, a lighter one at Night. The brand fill itself stays accent-fill.

tokens.name: on-selected
tokens.usage: Label and icon on selected: 7.9:1 light, 8.1:1 dark (WCAG AAA at any size).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring, 2px offset, around any focused control.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Search hits and 'new' markers behind ink-coloured text (14.9:1 light; use night text on the dark value).

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight: 14.9:1 light, 12.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rule-break and moderation notices on surface. The dark value is the Solarized scheme's own and reaches only 4.1:1 on night: use it at 19px bold and up, or pair it with an icon and parchment text.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and warning-of-loss text on surface and surface-raised: 7.7:1 or more in both themes (WCAG AAA). Always with a word or an icon; danger stays the fill for bars and marks.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Solved and approved states. The forum's own value: 3.8:1 on paper, 4.0:1 on night — icons, bars and 19px-bold labels only; always pair with a word or check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Passed, saved and approved text on surface and surface-raised: 7.7:1 or more in both themes. Always with a word or a check icon; success stays the fill for bars and marks.

tokens.name: caution-text
tokens.usage: Unusual-but-allowed notes on surface and surface-raised: 7.6:1 or more in both themes. Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: love
tokens.usage: Likes and reactions only.

tokens.name: festive-red
tokens.usage: Ground of the Valentine's Day and December Discord icons (Discord's own red). Seasonal avatars only; white marks on it reach 3.8:1, so no small text.

tokens.name: cat-red
tokens.usage: Category colour: Documentation, Wiki, Entertainment, The Newsroom, Assembled Nations, Archive, Economic Trade Agreements. Swatches and bars only, never a text ground.

tokens.name: cat-orange
tokens.usage: Category colour: The Pub, Future & Past, Videos, Military Trade, ATARA. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-amber
tokens.usage: Category colour: Academy, Non-Canon Works, Tasks, Space Initiative, Oriental States. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-lime
tokens.usage: Category colour: Technical Helpdesk, OOC Planning & Discussion, TRIDENT. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: Category colour: Factbooks and National Information, AEC. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-teal
tokens.usage: Category colour: Map of Eurth. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-sky
tokens.usage: Category colour: The Art Gallery. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-blue
tokens.usage: Category colour: Hello, my name is... and Affairs (the brand blue).

tokens.name: cat-cerulean
tokens.usage: Category colour: AL.

tokens.name: cat-vermilion
tokens.usage: Category colour: Diplomacy.

tokens.name: cat-grey
tokens.usage: Category colour: Business. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: cat-silver
tokens.usage: Category colour: Conflict. Swatches and bars only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a dialog. The only translucent colour.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One line on a featured banner or poster. Ink or parchment on surface, night or space.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The share-image tagline size. Main message of a share card or announcement.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Secondary headline, small-format graphics, Discord embeds.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The one headline of a hub or landing page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The h1 of a tool page or a written page.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Section headings (h2) on tool and written pages.

styles.name: cta
styles.usage: The 'eurth.org' pill: on-accent on accent-fill, large size only.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline: the category or notice type. Ink-muted, ink or accent-text.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Labels on accent-fill: the Join Eurth pill and primary buttons. 19px bold is the smallest size that counts as large text, which on-accent-small on accent-fill (4.7:1) needs for WCAG AAA.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The tool's name beside the yurt in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Our conworld is loosely based on the NationStates country simulation game.
styles.usage: Post body and any running text in a graphic.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Posted by the Eurth staff team

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dates, version numbers, coordinates and changelog lines.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Free, in your browser, no account needed.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph under a title.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: The smallest text: help under a control, tooltips. Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, swatch-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Kicker-to-headline gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on the forum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between navigation links.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Pill horizontal padding; gap between headline and CTA.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inner margin of small graphics (Discord, square).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Inner margin of banners and share cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Inner margin of 1500px-wide featured banners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small swatches and marks only.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Pills, buttons, inputs, cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatars, as the forum rounds them.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular marks: the yurt disc.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The forum's letter wrap: paper laid on a surface. The only box shadow in the brand.

tokens.name: canvas-featured
tokens.usage: Featured-topic thumbnail on the eurth.org homepage: 1500 x 500 px.

tokens.name: canvas-share
tokens.usage: Link preview (Open Graph) image: 1200 x 630 px, as Governmint and Flagwright use. One image serves Reddit, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack and WhatsApp.

tokens.name: canvas-wide
tokens.usage: Discord announcements and embeds: 1920 x 1080 px.

tokens.name: canvas-square
tokens.usage: Reddit, NationStates and Discord avatars: 1080 x 1080 px.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Smallest width and height of anything clickable (WCAG 2.5.5).

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Widest the page content grows.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Widest a column of running text grows.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring width and its offset.
